##


What Is Roblox Animal Hospital? How To Play It on Mobile?


#


**Animal Hospital Anomaly** launched on May 10, 2026 and quickly became[one of Roblox’s biggest horror hits](https://www.eurogamer.net/roblox-animal-hospital-all-characters) within two months. It runs on PC (Windows and macOS), consoles, and mobile (iOS and Android). To play on your phone, install **Roblox** first and search for[“Animal Hospital” from Animal Anomaly](https://www.roblox.com/games/78515283254292/Animal-Hospital) (not other copycat games).


Gameplay centers on check-in duty during a night shift at a veterinary clinic: you guide animal patients to the correct treatment, but some are secretly anomalies, and missing the signs can trigger a haunting that ends your shift. Surviving pays out campaign money plus permanent Animal Coins to buy ten *Classes* in-game.


*Animal Hospital characters from left to right: Dr. Harlow, Ron from Accounting, Ratthew, Barney*


Its story later reveals a shocking truth about their corporate employer: they’re deliberately infecting animal patients to transform them into lucrative, monstrous anomalies. Assisted by game characters and NPCs, the player must gather evidence to expose the company’s dark experiments and survive the night.


##


Meet Animal Hospital Characters: Ratthew, Dr. Harlow, Ron and Others


#


###


Ratthew


#


[Animal Hospital Ratthew](https://animal-hospital.fandom.com/wiki/Ratthew) (a portmanteau of “rat” and “Matthew”) is a small black rat with a white snout, large white buckteeth, and a curled pink tail. Paranoid but kind-hearted, he acts as a sincere and trustworthy assistant who always warns players of anomalies, unlike other characters who only appear to make demands. His backstory stays vague, centered on a missing twin sister, Rattina, and fans keep arguing over what he’s really hiding.


###


Dr. Harlow


#


[Dr. Harlow](https://animal-hospital.fandom.com/wiki/Dr._Harlow) is a light-orange, deer-like doctor in blue scrubs and a white coat, recognizable by his stethoscope, head mirror, and the black suitcase. He plays as a calm supervisor, grading your performance after each shift and unlocking new areas as you progress. While initially seen as a helpful character, later lore reveals his connection to a darker secret fans keep speculating.


###


Ron from Accounting


#


[Ron from Accounting](https://animal-hospital.fandom.com/wiki/Ron_from_Accounting) is one of the most-loved Animal Hospital characters: a blue bunny with short, wooped-back brown hair. Working for Animal Corporation, he knows about the hospital’s anomalies and casually leaks company secrets, while remaining calm and pragmatic, with a briefcase marked “TOP SECRET” in hand. Constant headaches keep him complaining, and his suspicious relationship with Ratthew ties back to the hospital’s cover-up.


###


Barney


#


[Barney](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/barney-u64c2gluws86) appears as a white rabbit with a mustache and black slit eyes, his[anomaly](https://animal-hospital.fandom.com/wiki/Anomalies) form swaps that for a sharp-toothed mouth and hollow black eyes. He is a serial killer who randomly walks up and friendly asks for a cup of coffee, then turns demanding and threatening if refused. Roblox Animal Hospital rewards mercy here: hide Barney instead of reporting him to Officer Duckman, and he’ll hand you an extra coffee machine.


###


Officer Duckman


#


[Officer Duckman](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/officer-duckman-edmddxi1f0cb) is a minor Roblox Animal Hospital character: a black duck-like figure in a blue shirt who shows up at reception after Shift 6 hunting Barney. Little is known about his background beyond that job. Turn Barney in, and Duckman shouts for you to arrest him, no reward included, just a reminder to keep reporting suspicious activity as your shift continues.


###


Liz


#


[Liz](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/liz-48e7t8tm2ekb) shows up later in the game (shift 11-12) and reveals more game lore. She is a light-brown fur caracal and disgraced former news reporter. Exaggerative and energetic, she was fired from Animal Corp for reporting on the Anomaly infection, which the corporation dismissed as “fake news”. She asks the player to help prove it, using a special UV camera on specific patients.


###


Rattina


#


[Rattina](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/rattina-8xq2v6mrqijm) is Ratthew’s missing twin sister and looks almost identical to him, except for a pink bow on her ear. She never physically appears in the game as an NPC, but remains a *central lore character* in Roblox Animal Hospital as the Animal Corporation employee who mysteriously disappeared. Players must collect keys from Ratthew to uncover Rattina’s hidden photo and secret, which reveal she was part of an experiment and transformed into ‘[The Stalker](https://animal-hospital.fandom.com/wiki/Stalker) ‘ (based on fan theories).


###


Other Roblox Animal Hospital characters


#


The rest of the cast takes on different roles in the hospital and contributes to Roblox Animal Hospital’s unique appeal, such as ******Shopkeeper Nurse****** who runs the Supplies shop, **News Bunny** – a news reporter who appears on the television, and **Sam** who helps players clean slime and get rid of Hiders. The game also features multiple charming characters as[Classes](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/roblox-animal-hospital-oc-maker#Robloxs_Animal_Hospital_OC_Maker_Create_Your_In-Game_Class) with distinctive appearances and special abilities that help players survive, such as **Secretary** , **Head Nurse** or **Secret Agent** .


###


New Character Rumors and Lore Expansion Update


#


Animal Hospital’s[August 8–11 Latest Update](https://animal-hospital.fandom.com/wiki/Updates) didn’t introduce a new named character. Instead, it unlocked a new area behind Dr. Harlow’s office, expanded his in-game lore, and added a Rain Shift bringing in a new fish-like patient species with cuter-looking, but just as capable of being a mimic. As for who’s next: Roblox’s listing schedules another update for **August 22, 2026** , but nothing’s confirmed yet. Fans’ top theory remains **Rattina** , Ratthew’s missing twin.

##


Frequently Asked Questions About Roblox Animal Hospital Anomaly


#


###


**Is Roblox Animal Hospital free on mobile?**


#


**Yes** . The game runs on both iOS and Android, and you need a Roblox account to play the game. This game is completely free to play on Roblox (which is also free to download). Optional in-game purchases are available using **Robux** (Roblox’s currency).


###


**Can I play Animal Hospital without Roblox?**


#


**No** . Animal Hospital is a Roblox experience, so it requires the Roblox app or platform account to play, though Roblox itself is available on PC, consoles, and mobile.


###


Is Roblox Animal Hospital a role-playing game?


#


**No** . Roblox Animal Hospital is a survival horror game inspired by titles like *Scary Shawarma Kiosk* and *Dandy’s World* , with “spot the anomaly” puzzle gameplay – you check in animal patients and spot disguised monsters (like the Skinwalker or Stalker) before they attack you. It’s also a **multiplayer** game where you can team up with friends, though you can experience its secrets on your own. If you want to actually **roleplay as these characters** — holding conversations, directing the story —[Redbean lets you do that with any of Animal Hospital cast](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/roblox-animal-hospital-roleplay) .


###


**Beginner tips on how to play Roblox Animal Hospital Anomaly**


#


Here are some Roblox Animal Hospital practical gameplay tips to help you manage sanity, detect anomalies and deal with NPCs:


- Grab **coffee** at the start of every shift (refills ~3 minutes); take 2 sips before handing it to NPCs who need it (e.g Barney) to keep your Sanity buff, and coffee can also extinguish candles during rituals.
- Revolvers, tasers, and fire extinguishers can handle most anomalies; extinguishers also clear slime fast and reveal invisible ghosts (but cannot kill), and you can give the **wrong medicine** to kill anomaly patients instead of refusing them.
- Carefully inspect **eyes, ears, face, and seizures** —small differences often reveal anomalies, even patients on fire. **Black eyes** or **abnormal seizures** = guaranteed anomaly; confirm before inspecting, since a cursed shot costs -10 Sanity.
- Some disguises (like Walker) are extremely convincing, so monitor suspicious behavior rather than appearance alone.
- Specific anomalies need specific counters: syrup or organs for the under-the-bed monster, coffee for the head-banging one, and ignoring ceiling eyes.
- Always help Barney instead of reporting him for a reward (a coffee machine).


###


**Is Animal Hospital Ratthew an anomaly?**


#


**No** . **Ratthew** is **not** an anomaly, even though he sometimes behaves strangely and his prolonged eye contact with the camera reads as unsettling. Among main Animal Hospital characters, Barney is an anomaly, but he’s harmless to players. You can find[instructions on detecting anomalies in the game here.](https://www.ign.com/wikis/animal-hospital-roblox/All_Anomalies)


###


What is the relationship between Ratthew and Rattina?


#


They are twin rat siblings in the game. Rattina worked for the Animal Corporation before vanishing without explanation, and Ratthew is on a quest to find her, which is tied to an unresolved mystery that fans are still theorizing about.
